messages:
lex: Cutting an RC candidate: rc-2025-06-24-34 (sha: a1b2c3d). Requesting sign-off to queue a prod canary during today's change window 18:00-19:00 PT. Will pin artifact to release-registry as v0.42.2-rc34. @deploy-bot please queue canary.

deploy-bot: Received request. Queuing canary for rc-2025-06-24-34 -> prod-canary. ETA ~10m. CI checks: unit+smoke passed. Command run: ```/deploy promote rc-2025-06-24-34 --to=prod-canary --by=lex```

aj: Quick pre-checks: staging migrations applied, perf-ci green (90th pct within baseline). No DB schema changes that touch prod-critical tables.

maria: Observability hooks added, dashboards: /dash/rc-34 and alerts hooked to #oncall. I'll watch latency and error rate during canary. :eyes:

srujan: Can we add a fallback routing rule to fallback-model-small if p50 > 300ms? I'll push the routing config if folks agree.

lex: Yes please add fallback. Also pin the artifact now in the release dashboard so rollback target is clear. Pin to: release-registry/redwood/v0.42.2-rc34.

jen: QA started post-canary smoke. Running top-level flows (auth, search, generate). I'll flag any flake immediately.

qa-bot: Smoke tests started: auth ok, search ok, generate: running. 

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started. Logs: ```Deploying rc-2025-06-24-34 to prod-canary
> pulling image a1b2c3d
> configuring routes
> applying config: routing-fallback=enabled
> healthchecks: ok
Canary started at 2025-06-24T18:05:12Z```

maria: Canary metrics - first 5m: error_rate 0.6%, p50 latency 220ms, p95 430ms. no obvious spikes.

jen: QA smoke passing: 9/10. One intermittent search edge case failing (timeout ~800ms) — investigating whether it's infra or model.

srujan: I deployed fallback route to fallback-model-small with weight 0.1 for requests with seq_len>1024. Also added temporary route cap to avoid cascading.

lex: Good. Decision on promotion criteria: if canary maintains error_rate < 1.5% and p95 < 500ms for 15m, promote to prod. Rollback if error_rate > 2% or sustained p95 > 600ms for 5m. Agreement?

aj: Agreed from infra side. Also request we limit initial traffic ramp to 20% for 10m then 50% for 15m, then full.

maria: Agreed. I'll run alert thresholds and paging policy.

jen: QA gives conditional sign-off — will re-run full regression post-20% ramp.

lex: Noted. Locking the change window: promotion earliest at 18:30 PT. Pinning artifact now.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 2025-06-24T18:30:00-07:00. Promotion plan: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks at each step. Command: ```/deploy promote rc-2025-06-24-34 --to=prod --strategy=ramped --steps=20,50,100 --monitor=15m```

maria: Monitoring live. Oncall: @srujan, you're the primary pager for this rollout.

srujan: Oncall ack. I'll escalate if remediation needed.

deploy-bot: Starting promotion: step 1 (20%). Time: 18:30:05Z.

maria: Step1 metrics (5m): error_rate 0.8%, p50 240ms, p95 460ms. All steady.

jen: Full regression hit started: 0/12 failures so far.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to step2 (50%) at 18:40:30Z.

maria: Step2 metrics (5m): error_rate 1.1%, p50 255ms, p95 490ms. No alert.

jen: Regression 10/12 passing, two flaky search cases reproducing. Investigating stack traces.

srujan: Seeing a small uptick in p95 on one AZ, routing temporarily shifted away from that AZ.

lex: If the flaky search is not user-facing at scale, continue ramp. If errors spike beyond threshold, rollback. Keep me posted.

jen: Tests still noisy but user impact looks minimal. I'm OK to continue to 100% after one more 10m observation.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to step3 (100%) at 18:55:00Z. Finalizing.

maria: Post-promo metrics (10m): error_rate 1.3%, p50 270ms, p95 520ms. Under rollback rules. No page.

lex: Rollback decision criteria reminder posted: rollback to v0.42.1 if error_rate > 2% OR p95 > 600ms sustained 5m. Current metrics acceptable. Proceeding to close the RC.

deploy-bot: Artifact pin recorded: release-registry/redwood/v0.42.2-rc34 pinned -> prod. Release notes auto-generated: "rc-34: perf improvements, routing fallback, minor search fixes".

jen: Marking post-deploy QA status: conditional-pass. Will open follow-up bug for flaky search edge case.

aj: Infra checks green, autoscaling healthy. No throttles.

lex: Signing off. RC rc-2025-06-24-34 promoted to prod and pinned. Thank you everyone. :tada:

srujan: SRE sign-off. Leaving monitoring on for 24h.

deploy-bot: Thread closed: promotion complete. Logs archived to /artifacts/releases/rc-2025-06-24-34/logs.tar.gz
